records.name: Potatoism / Potato of Life
records.why_foundational: Provides the central project grammar, purpose, symbols and relational method from which the current House, Great Book, philosophy and research architecture branch.

clocks.label: Project retains this as Tim's mythic Potato birth / Potatoism seed.
Potato persona/community grows into deeper reflective system; by 2023 'Potato of Life' crystallizes.
Great Book system-building turns Potato into explicit spiritual, philosophical and systems language.
April turning reorganizes Potato/Sage material into Ladder/Axis/Father-side architecture.
Potatoism becomes an explicit searchable evidence-aware atlas layer in the repository.

foundation_rules: cultivation rather than conquest as mature ethic
provenance and evidence classes remain distinct
later theology should not be projected backward without source evidence

records.name: Danish constitutional order
records.why_foundational: Constitutes the modern Danish state order while later parliamentary practice adds unwritten load-bearing conventions.

clocks.label: First Danish constitution signed.
Parliamentary government becomes established in practice.
Current Constitutional Act adopted.

records.name: Constitution of the United States
records.why_foundational: Creates the continuing federal constitutional framework and an amendment/interpretation platform.

clocks.label: Constitution signed.
Ninth-state ratification satisfies Article VII threshold.
Proceedings under the Constitution begin.

records.name: Charter of the United Nations
records.why_foundational: Constitutes the United Nations, its purposes, principles, membership and principal organs.

clocks.label: Charter signed in San Francisco.
Charter enters into force; organization is born legally.

records.name: European integration / European Union treaty foundation
records.why_foundational: EU authority is layered rather than born once: successive treaties build, widen and re-found the legal platform.

clocks.label: ECSC Treaty signed.
ECSC Treaty enters into force.
Treaties of Rome signed.
Treaties of Rome enter into force.
Maastricht Treaty signed.
Maastricht enters into force and establishes the European Union.

records.name: European Convention on Human Rights
records.why_foundational: Turns selected human-rights commitments into binding treaty obligations and enforcement architecture.

clocks.label: Opened for signature in Rome.
Convention enters into force.

records.name: North Atlantic Treaty / NATO
records.why_foundational: A short treaty creates the legal center around which alliance institutions, membership and doctrine later develop.

clocks.label: North Atlantic Treaty signed by 12 founding members.
Treaty enters into force.

records.name: International Monetary Fund
records.why_foundational: The Articles create a standing monetary-cooperation institution and define its mandate, governance, member rights and operational rules.

clocks.label: Articles finalized/adopted at Bretton Woods.
Articles enter into force.
IMF begins financial operations.

records.name: European Central Bank
records.why_foundational: Creates the central institutional node of the Eurosystem/ESCB and the operational platform for the euro's single monetary policy.

clocks.label: ECB and ESCB established.

foundation_rules: Governing Council and Executive Board structure

records.name: Danmarks Nationalbank
records.why_foundational: Created as an independent note-issuing institution after monetary collapse, making institutional independence and currency trust part of Denmark's financial platform.

clocks.label: Danmarks Nationalbank established.
Current Nationalbank Act reorganizes/codifies institution.

records.name: Christianity
records.why_foundational: A first-century Jesus movement becomes a durable translocal religious community, canon/creed tradition and family of churches.

clocks.label: Jesus movement and earliest Christian communities emerge from Second Temple Jewish context.
Council of Nicaea produces an enduring creedal foundation for major Christian traditions.

foundation_rules: later creedal and ecclesial rules vary by branch

records.name: Judaism / Israelite-to-rabbinic formation
records.why_foundational: No single historical birthday adequately captures Judaism; its foundation is layered across Israelite religion, Torah/scripturalization, Second Temple institutions and later rabbinic consolidation.

clocks.label: Israelite religion develops within ancient Near Eastern contexts.
Torah/scriptural legal authority becomes increasingly central in Judean/Jewish identity.
Rabbinic movement develops in post-Temple conditions; later rabbinization is gradual.

foundation_rules: rabbinic legal-discursive reproduction in later traditions

records.name: Islam / early umma
records.why_foundational: Revelation/preaching becomes a durable community and legal-social order; Hijra/Medina is a major operative foundation point rather than the only possible 'start'.

clocks.label: Islamic tradition locates the beginning of Qur'anic revelation and Muhammad's preaching in Mecca.
Hijra to Yathrib/Medina marks beginning of Islamic era and a new communal order.
Constitution of Medina deeds formalize aspects of the early umma/community.

foundation_rules: Qur'an and Sunnah as later legal/doctrinal foundations

records.name: Buddhism / early Sangha
records.why_foundational: The Buddha's teaching and the Sangha create a reproducible community of practice whose monastic discipline becomes a durable platform for transmission.

clocks.label: Historical Buddha is generally placed in northern India in the fifth century BCE.
Early Buddhist community/Sangha is established around teaching and discipline.

records.name: Sikh tradition / Khalsa
records.why_foundational: Guru Nanak's teaching begins a Guru lineage; the Khalsa later creates a distinct disciplined community form.

clocks.label: Guru Nanak's teaching and early Sikh community.
Guru Gobind Singh founds/inaugurates the Khalsa at Vaisakhi.

records.name: Bahá’í Faith
records.why_foundational: The faith carries multiple explicit foundation clocks: Bábí precursor, Bahá’u’lláh's declaration, and later elected global governance.

clocks.label: The Báb inaugurates his mission, forming the immediate precursor field.
Bahá’u’lláh's Riḍván declaration marks emergence of the Bahá’í Faith from the Bábí movement.
Universal House of Justice first elected.

foundation_rules: Universal House of Justice legislative role in uncovered matters

records.name: Daoist traditions
records.why_foundational: Classical Daoist texts and later organized religious Daoism are distinct foundation clocks rather than one founder event.

clocks.label: Classical Daoist textual traditions associated with Daodejing and Zhuangzi develop.
Traditional date for Zhang Daoling/Celestial Masters covenant; organized community becomes a major religious foundation.

records.name: Confucian / Ru traditions
records.why_foundational: Confucius becomes a central teacher in a longer ritual-scholarly field; Han classification/state-linked institutions later consolidate 'Confucian' tradition.

clocks.label: Confucius and early Ru teaching tradition.
Philosophical school categories/commentarial traditions and state-linked forms consolidate.

records.name: Stoicism
records.why_foundational: A teacher/place/method becomes a reproducible Hellenistic school whose physics, logic and ethics form an integrated foundation.

clocks.label: Zeno of Citium founds the Stoic school around the Stoa Poikile in Athens.

records.name: Epicurean Garden
records.why_foundational: Epicurus's Garden is simultaneously place, community and lived philosophical platform.

clocks.label: Epicurus moves to Athens and founds the Garden community/school.

foundation_rules: continuity after founder through community/property arrangements

records.name: Platonic Academy
records.why_foundational: An evolving philosophical association tied to place and teacher becomes a durable school lineage without a modern charter-style founding.

clocks.label: Plato's group gradually coalesces at the Academy; modern scholars often assign c. 387–383 BCE but a single legal founding date is misleading.

foundation_rules: doctrinal diversity within a recognizable school

records.name: Aristotle's Lyceum / Peripatetic school
records.why_foundational: Aristotle establishes a research/teaching school whose collection, lecture and inquiry practices reproduce a distinctive intellectual programme.

clocks.label: Aristotle returns to Athens and establishes his school in rented buildings at the Lyceum.

records.name: University of Copenhagen
records.why_foundational: An unusually clear multi-clock case: authorization, inauguration, Reformation refoundation and later statutory platform.

clocks.label: Pope Sixtus IV grants permission to establish a university in Denmark.
University formally inaugurated; official birthday.
University resumes after Reformation under changed religious/social role.
Detailed university foundation/statute defines framework for roughly two centuries.

records.name: Royal Society
records.why_foundational: Shows the difference between community birth, legal incorporation and later charter refoundation.

clocks.label: First meeting of the new Fellowship after Christopher Wren's lecture.
First Royal Charter incorporates the Society.
Modern Supplemental Charter receives Royal Seal and becomes governing document.

records.name: Montessori education
records.why_foundational: A concrete prepared environment and observed practice precede worldwide codification of a pedagogical method.

clocks.label: First Casa dei Bambini opens in San Lorenzo, Rome.
First training course and first major method publication.

records.name: Bauhaus
records.why_foundational: A school and manifesto create a platform linking art, craft, architecture and pedagogy whose influence outlives the institution.

clocks.label: Walter Gropius's Bauhaus manifesto/program crystallizes the school in Weimar.
Historical Bauhaus institution operates across Weimar, Dessau and Berlin.

records.name: CERN
records.why_foundational: A convention converts postwar scientific cooperation into shared physical infrastructure and governance.

clocks.label: CERN Convention signed by 12 founding states.
Convention enters into force; official foundation date.

records.name: World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)
records.why_foundational: A coordination institution turns an already-growing Web into a standards-governed interoperable platform.

clocks.label: W3C founded.

branches: HTML/CSS/Web APIs/accessibility standards and working groups

records.name: Wikimedia Foundation
records.why_foundational: Creates a durable legal/technical support platform beneath volunteer-created free-knowledge projects.

clocks.label: Wikipedia launches as predecessor knowledge project.
Wikimedia Foundation announced/founded as stable nonprofit base.

foundation_rules: volunteer/community production remains distinct from Foundation governance

records.name: A.P. Moller - Maersk
records.why_foundational: Shows company foundation as both formal incorporation and an autonomy move away from predecessor governance.

clocks.label: Steamship Company Svendborg established; official Maersk foundation.
Steamship Company of 1912 created, securing A.P. Møller greater operational independence.

records.name: ASML
records.why_foundational: A joint venture turns pre-existing Philips lithography R&D into an autonomous commercial platform.

clocks.label: Philips and ASM announce intention to form a lithography joint venture.
ASM Lithography commences operations.

foundation_rules: integration of inherited R&D with new resources/market discipline

records.name: Novo Nordisk
records.why_foundational: The present company is a merger/refoundation of two older insulin enterprises, so predecessor foundations remain causally and institutionally relevant.

clocks.label: Nordisk insulin activities begin; first patients treated with Danish insulin in March.
Novo Terapeutisk Laboratorium founded by Harald and Thorvald Pedersen.
Novo and Nordisk merge to form Novo Nordisk A/S.
